text.en:
Composition and Compensation. The Consulting Group shall be composed of highly trained
technical men and specialists with sufficient experience in the field of international finance development as
well as in financial operations of government and government-controlled corporations to be hired by the
Secretary of Finance on contractual basis.
Any provision of law to the contrary notwithstanding the hiring of specialists and consultants as well as
appointment to positions created under Section 3 hereof shall be exempt from the requirements and

restrictions of the Civil Service Law, rules and regulations and those of the Office of Compensation and
Position Classification (OCPC).

Consultants and Exports. The Secretary of Finance is hereby authorized to create positions as
may be needed, or contract or hire individuals, or enter into contracts with organizations of recognized
competence in the field of development finance; Provided, That contracts for the services of an expert or
consultant shall not exceed the sum of Four Thousand Pesos (P4,000.00) per month.

Transportation and Representation Allowances. Any provision of law to the contrary
notwithstanding all consultants and specialists on contractual basis and such technical personnel duly
appointed by the Secretary as the needs of the service may require shall be granted commutable transportation
and representation allowances at rate to be fixed by the Secretary of Finance.

Relationship with Other Entities. The Consulting Group, shall, in the furtherance of its functions
and duties, cooperate and coordinate with government and private entities as well as international
organizations involved in activities related to its functions.

Appropriations. To carry out the functions of the group herein created, there is hereby
appropriated the sum of Nine Hundred Thousand Pesos (P900,000.00) out of any funds in the National
Treasury not otherwise appropriated. The same amount or such amount as shall be needed shall be included in
the Annual General Appropriations Decree for the continued operation of the group.

Repealing Clause. Any provision of law, decree, order, rules or regulations contrary to or
inconsistent herewith are hereby repealed, revised or amended accordingly.

Effectivity. This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 25th day of May, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
